sources.title: Facial-Attribute-Detection - Qualcomm AI Hub
sources.snippet: Facial-Attribute-Detection Comprehensive facial analysis by extracting face features. Detects attributes (eye closeness, mask presence, eyeglasses presence, sunglasses presence) that apply to a given face. This model's architecture was developed by Qualcomm. The model was trained by Qualcomm on a proprietary dataset of faces, but can be used on any image.
